stops.title: Alpine → Tucson → Fort Stockton
stops.description: I-8 to I-10 through El Paso. Two days, ~810 miles. OPEN MIC NOTES: Sky Bar (536 N 4th Ave) — Wed open mic 7 PM–midnight, sign up 5:30 PM. Laffs Comedy Cafe (2900 E Broadway) — Thu comedy open mic 8 PM (21+). Neither Sun nor Mon open mics confirmed in Tucson; best strategy is to check openmicaustin.com/tucson listings and the Tucson Open Mic-ers Facebook group for any pop-ups on Apr 12 (Sun) or Apr 13 (Mon).

stops.title: Wimberley / Austin / Hill Country
stops.description: Family base. Cheatham Street Wednesday Apr 15 (sign up 8 PM, play 9). Austin scouting Thursday. Luckenbach picker circle if time allows. Rest/record Friday. OPEN MIC NOTES: TUESDAY Apr 14 — Cactus Cafe Songwriters' Open Mic, 2308 Whitis Ave (UT campus), doors 7 PM, show 7:30–9:30 PM, free, original music only, sign up 7–7:25 PM in person OR email jakefarrmusic@gmail.com in advance. THURSDAY Apr 16 — (1) Austin Songwriters Group at Threadgill's, 301 W Riverside Dr, sign up 6:30 PM, music 7–9:45 PM, original preferred, 2 songs first 10 performers; (2) Fox & Locke Open Mic, 4142 Old Hillsboro Rd, Franklin (near Nashville direction, skip on this leg), Thu 6:30 PM, text 615-802-8585 between 3–3:30 PM day-of; (3) Dozen Street open mic Wed 5:30–8 PM (Scooter Holiday host), sign up 5 PM. FRIDAY Apr 17 — No major songwriter open mic confirmed on Fridays in Austin; check openmicaustin.com for current listings. Middleton Brewing (101 Oakwood Loop, San Marcos/Wimberley area) has live music Fri/Sat/Sun, call ahead for songwriter open mic schedule.

stops.title: Wimberley → Dallas area
stops.description: ~200 miles, positioning day. OPEN MIC NOTES: SATURDAY — Opening Bell Coffee, 1409 Botham Jean Blvd, Dallas. Open mic Sat 4–6 PM, free, all ages, first come first play (sign-up sheet at venue starting 4 PM). Acoustic/keyboards preferred, original material welcomed, 2 songs or 10 min per set. Longest-running open mic in DFW (since 2005). Dan's Silverleaf (Mon songwriter open mic, not applicable Sat). Check openmicdallas.com for any other Saturday options.

stops.title: Memphis
stops.description: Arrive Sunday via I-30/I-40. Sun Studio, Stax Museum, Beale Street, busk. OPEN MIC NOTES: SUNDAY Apr 19 — No confirmed weekly songwriter/acoustic open mic found for Sunday in Memphis. South Main Sounds (550 S Main St) hosts songwriter nights primarily Thu–Sat; call ahead (check southmainsounds.com). The Cove (2559 Broad Ave) has live jazz Thu/Sun — verify if they do an open mic on Sundays. Hi Tone Cafe (282–284 N Cleveland, Crosstown area) hosts mix of concerts and open mics; check hitonecafe.com for Sunday listing. MONDAY Apr 20 — No confirmed Monday music open mic found. Monday Night Poetry Open Mic at 282–284 N Cleveland St (Hi Tone area). Best strategy: check wearememphis.com live music calendar and the Memphis Open Mic Circuit Facebook group for current Sun/Mon listings week-of. Busking on Beale Street is the reliable fallback both days.
stops.accommodation: Two nights at T.O. Fuller State Park (~$25/night).

stops.title: Memphis → Nashville
stops.description: ~210 miles, 3 hours. Afternoon scouting — neighborhoods, venues. OPEN MIC NOTES: TUESDAY Apr 21 — Multiple options: (1) Douglas Corner Cafe, 2106 8th Ave S Suite A — open mic Tue 8 PM, call 615-292-2530 between 1–6 PM day-of to sign up, 2 original songs per performer, legendary songwriter room. (2) Pitch Meeting at Analog at Hutton Hotel, 1808 W End Ave — Tue doors 6:30 PM, sign-ups 7 PM, music 7:30 PM, free 21+, backed by house band, contact pitchmusic.org or (615) 721-2685. (3) Commodore Grille (Holiday Inn Vanderbilt), 2613 W End Ave — Tue 6–10 PM, hosted by Jimmy and Anna-Lisa, sign-ups at 6 PM, open mic rounds begin 9 PM, free, all ages, original songs only. (4) Cafe Coco Writers Night, 210 Louise Ave — Tue/Thu 8–10:30 PM, sign-ups 7 PM (fill fast, arrive early) — NOTE: verify status, listed as possibly closed on Yelp March 2026.
stops.accommodation: One night, Bells Bend (free) or Seven Points (~$25).

stops.title: Nashville → Wilkesboro
stops.description: ~350 miles, 5.5 hours. Set up camp, get oriented. OPEN MIC NOTES: WEDNESDAY Apr 22 (brief Nashville stop before driving) — If leaving after noon: Analog Nashville / Southern Rounds at Analog (1808 W End Ave) on Wednesdays at 7 PM (songwriter rounds, not open mic). Music Row Freak Show (110 28th Ave N) Tue/Thu 7 PM. If morning departure, skip Nashville open mic this night.

stops.title: MerleFest
stops.description: Wilkesboro, NC. Pickin' Place jams, soak in the scene.
stops.accommodation: Off-site camping (North Wilkesboro Speedway, Sewerfest, or W. Kerr Scott Reservoir fallback).

stops.title: Asheville
stops.description: 90 min from Wilkesboro. Monday open mics: One World Brewing (7:30 sign-up), Jack of the Wood (9 PM). TUESDAY Apr 28 OPEN MIC NOTES: (1) White Horse Black Mountain, 105-C Montreat Rd, Black Mountain NC (20 min east of Asheville) — open mic every Tuesday, arrive by 6:45 PM, names drawn at 6:50 PM for 12 slots, show ~7 PM, 3 songs or 15 min per performer. Legendary listening room, very songwriter-friendly. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED. (2) UpCountry Brewing, 1042 Haywood Rd, Asheville — music Tue 8 PM (hosted by Arrow Sound). (3) Sovereign Kava (Asheville) — Music Open Jam every Tuesday 8 PM. Check livemusicasheville.com for week-of updates.

stops.title: Bristol
stops.description: Birthplace of Country Music Museum, Radio Bristol (ask about a live session), busk State Street. OPEN MIC NOTES: WEDNESDAY Apr 29 — (1) The Corner, 501 State St, Bristol VA 24201 — open mic every Wednesday hosted by TJ Darnell, 8–11 PM, all talent welcome. Confirmed recurring through 2026. (2) Blue Ridge Comedy Club, 560 English St, Bristol TN 37620 — Wed comedy open mic, sign-up sheet 7:30 PM, show 8 PM, free. (3) Bloom Cafe & Listening Room — first Wednesday of the month only (not applicable Apr 29). The Corner on State Street is the most songwriter-friendly option and is right on the historic State Street line.

stops.title: Nashville
stops.description: Full week. Commodore Grille open mics (Sun/Mon/Wed/Thu, sign up 5:45 PM). Bluebird Cafe Monday May 4 (sign up online 11:00 AM CT sharp). Music Row Freak Show Wednesday May 6. Busk East Nashville, 12 South, Five Points. Scout housing/neighborhoods. Deadlines: Golden Pick submission May 1. Rocky Mountain Folks Fest Songwriter Showcase ~May 6. OPEN MIC NOTES — TUESDAY nights (May 5): (1) Douglas Corner Cafe, 2106 8th Ave S — Tue 8 PM, call 615-292-2530 between 1–6 PM day-of, 2 original songs. (2) Pitch Meeting at Analog/Hutton Hotel, 1808 W End Ave — Tue doors 6:30 PM, sign-up 7 PM, show 7:30 PM, free 21+, house band backs performers. (3) Commodore Grille — also open Tue 6–10 PM (Jimmy & Anna-Lisa hosting). FRIDAY nights (May 1, May 8): (1) Commodore Grille, 2613 W End Ave — Nashville Songwriter's Showcase Fri 7–10 PM (rounds), open mic rounds begin ~10 PM, free, all ages, original songs only, sign up 6 PM. (2) 3rd and Lindsley, 816 3rd Ave S — 'Finally Friday' free live radio show noon–2 PM with WMOT Roots Radio (daytime listening). SATURDAY nights (May 2, May 9): (1) Commodore Grille — Nashville Songwriter's Showcase Sat 7–10 PM, same format as Friday. (2) Bluebird Cafe, 4104 Hillsboro Pike — Tue–Sat early show 6–7:45 PM (up-and-coming writers, ticketed), late show 9 PM (hit writers). For Bluebird Sat performance: must pass quarterly audition or attend Monday open mic first. Check bluebirdcafe.com/calendar weekly.
stops.accommodation: Bells Bend or Seven Points base camp.

stops.title: Nashville → Wimberley
stops.description: Two days via Little Rock. I-40 to I-30 to I-35.
stops.accommodation: Arkansas rest stop or Ozark NF overnight. Free.

stops.title: Wimberley / Austin / Hill Country
stops.description: Family base. Austin open mics. Cheatham Street Wednesday May 13. Luckenbach picker circles. Austin Songwriters Group events. Annotation work, recording, set prep for Kerrville. OPEN MIC NOTES — SUNDAY (May 10, 17): Speakeasy (412 Congress Ave) hosts Mon open mic; no confirmed Sun songwriter open mic in Austin. Check openmicaustin.com. MONDAY (May 11, 18): (1) Speakeasy, 412 Congress Ave — Mon 8–11:30 PM, hosted by Ronnie Hall. (2) Austin Songwriters Group at Threadgill's, 301 W Riverside Dr — Mon sign-up 6:30 PM, music 7–9:45 PM, 2 songs (first 10 performers), original preferred. (3) Cactus Cafe (UT), 2308 Whitis Ave — Tue only (see below). TUESDAY (May 12, 19): Cactus Cafe Songwriters' Open Mic, 2308 Whitis Ave — doors 7 PM, show 7:30–9:30 PM, free, original music only, sign up 7–7:25 PM or email jakefarrmusic@gmail.com. THURSDAY (May 14): Fox & Locke, 4142 Old Hillsboro Rd, Franklin TN — NOT practical from Wimberley. Austin: Austin Songwriters Group at Threadgill's also meets Thursdays per some sources — verify. FRIDAY (May 15): No confirmed songwriter open mic in Austin on Fridays; check openmicaustin.com. SATURDAY (May 16): No confirmed songwriter open mic in Austin on Saturdays. Middleton Brewing (101 Oakwood Loop, San Marcos) has live music Fri/Sat/Sun — call ahead to check for open mic format.
stops.accommodation: Book McKinney Falls for late nights, ~$20/night.

stops.title: Cheatham Street → Kerrville
stops.description: Third Cheatham Street visit — dress rehearsal of Kerrville set. Drive to Quiet Valley Ranch (~1.5 hrs from San Marcos).

stops.title: Kerrville Folk Festival
stops.description: Quiet Valley Ranch, Kerrville, TX. Tickets purchased. Campground culture. New Folk Competition May 23–24 (attend as audience, submit for 2027). Up to 18 days.
